title: AI Deployment Accountability Engineering: A Vision for Accountable AI in Safety-Critical Socio-Technical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.14592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents.   This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. translated_title: AI部署问责工程：面向安全关键社会技术系统中可问责人工智能的愿景
translated_abstract: 人工智能系统正迅速成为医疗、金融、公共服务以及其他安全关键领域的关键组成部分。然而，用于评估这些系统的工程实践仍然主要局限于以模型为中心的范式，强调部署前模型在准确性、鲁棒性、公平性和可解释性等方面的属性。这些属性固然必要，但当AI系统处于一个不断变化的社会技术环境中运行时，它们就显得不够充分——这样的环境具有分布漂移、制度约束、人类反馈回路、隐私要求以及多个AI智能体之间的交互等特征。这篇愿景论文提出了AI部署问责工程（ADAE），这是一个旨在为已部署AI系统建立可衡量、持续且可操作的问责机制的AI工程子学科。ADAE将问责视为一种部署层属性，而不仅仅是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AI部署问责工程（ADAE）这一新子学科，主张将问责作为部署层属性，为运行在安全关键社会技术环境中的AI系统建立可衡量、持续且可操作的问责机制。
en_tdlr: This vision paper proposes AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a new subdiscipline that treats accountability as a deployment-layer property to establish measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for AI systems operating in safety-critical socio-technical environments.
